name: components/avatar
description: A user avatar primitive with image/fallback composition and an AvatarGroup helper for stacked team presence. Supports delayed fallback rendering for slow image loads, overflow count handling, and theme-aware class overrides.
useCases: User profile photos in app headers, comments, and activity feeds
Team member presence rows in dashboards and project cards
Assignee chips in task lists with fallback initials when images fail
Collaborator stacks on files, docs, and pull request review UIs
usage: import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarGroup, AvatarImage } from "shadcn-solid-components/components/avatar"
